attributes.name: duty
attributes.digest: Duty Cycle
attributes.description: Sets the warping of the LFO waveform. Values between -1 and 0 stretch the start of the waveform and compress the end. Values between 0 and 1 compress the start and compress the end.

attributes.description: When spin is on, stereo phase offset is disabled. Spin allows changing the relative frequencies of the left and right channels by a given spin factor.
